svg.text: Project A: LKDR Games Event (Spin the Wheel + Lucky Dip) | Project B: Treasure Hunt | One LKDR Admin Dashboard
Numbers on the diagram match the flow table below
Spin the Wheel and Lucky Dip
Code exchange: ID token with an opaque user ID
Public keys (JWKS), silent re-login, name lookup API
Calls our scan intake API on every scan (server to server)
Signed (HMAC), unique scan ID, retried if our API is busy
WebSocket sync with the stall screen
Spin the Wheel and Lucky Dip
One play per user per session,
Scans a game or stall logo and signs in with a QuickLook account.
Posts the scan event (opaque user ID, logo ID, scan ID, time), signed with HMAC.
Checks the signature, stores the scan once, publishes scan.received with the logo type.
Redirects to our callback with a one-time code, the scan ID and a state value.
Opens the callback and then the game or hunt pages and APIs over HTTPS.
Swaps the code for an ID token, sets a short signed session cookie. Silent re-login when it expires.
Creates the entry (scan, session, one play per session, screen lock), plays, returns prize and reference.
WebSocket messages: now playing, animation target, result, ready.
Stall scans go to the Treasure Hunt queue. The worker adds points once per stall per session.
Shows the scan result, my score and rank, and the leaderboard.
Reads the leaderboard every few seconds from the CloudFront cache.
Admin login with roles, then Project A and Project B admin tabs.
Each project uses its own table. Only opaque QuickLook IDs are stored.
Opens and closes sessions on time and releases expired screen locks.
